title: Source summary
description: What the source reader learns from a site's code, read where the site lives: entry points, the type the code gives each input, where an input reaches a risky call, components and versions. Names, types and paths only: never code, never values, never secrets. The source reader sends it to the panel, the panel to the agent.

stack.description: What the reader recognised: an application it knows (at the site's root or in one of its folders), a custom PHP site, or nothing

skipped.description: Too large, secrets, uploads, caches, not code

known.description: Files of the application's core and of libraries: known code, not read (only the core's version files are)

truncated.description: The reader stopped at its limits

path.description: Public path as the map writes it ({name} for a parameter); with query, the entry script the query selects in

action.description: wp_ajax and admin_post: the action value (also in query)

query.description: The fixed query values that select the entry point in its script: action=x (WordPress AJAX, MediaWiki API), option=com_x (Joomla), route=x (OpenCart), fc, module and controller (PrestaShop), eID (TYPO3), title=Special:X (MediaWiki), info (Moodle)

public.description: Reachable without logging in, as the code says (wp_ajax_nopriv, a REST permission callback __return_true, Drupal's _access TRUE, Magento's anonymous resource, Moodle's loginrequired false, a PHP file opened directly); false when the code does not say

source.description: $_GET, $_POST, $_REQUEST (and each application's own reader of either: Moodle's optional_param, Joomla's input, Symfony's query and request (Drupal, phpBB), MediaWiki's WebRequest, phpBB's variable, TYPO3's Extbase arguments, OpenCart's request, PrestaShop's Tools::getValue, Magento's getParam)

values.description: enum: the values the code compares it with

route.description: The route of the file or handler that reads it, when known

input.description: The request key that reaches the call, when the reader sees it

origin.description: Where the entry point comes from: WordPress (rest_route, wp_ajax, wp_ajax_nopriv, admin_post), a PHP file a browser opens (php_file), or the application's own declaration

codeType.description: What the code makes of the input: int (absint, intval, (int), PARAM_INT, getInt), bool, email (sanitize_email, is_email), url (esc_url_raw), key (sanitize_key, getCmd, PARAM_ALPHANUMEXT: letters, digits, _ and -), slug (sanitize_title), enum (compared with fixed values), text (sanitize_text_field, PARAM_TEXT), html (wp_kses, PARAM_CLEANHTML), unknown (used raw)

owner.description: The extension the file belongs to ("plugin akismet", "module webform", "extension vendor/name"); absent for the site's own code
